scope: Underwater uses a compact header and action dock, with optional Sites, Contacts and Details pages. Site selection closes the drawer; real time forecasts, ecology and turn reports remain available on demand. Shift+Space quiet listening resolves shorter-range acoustic contacts for two power and one hour, excluding silent minerals. Active sonar spends twelve power, reaches farther and temporarily alarms visible wildlife; alarm decay follows committed hours. After a deliberate Study, Enter can freely replan to a genuine resolved unstudied contact, unless hull damage or full cargo prioritizes recovery. C remains optional finite/ecological sampling, K deliberately returns and Enter then continues home. Manual routes, pressure ascent, honest debriefs and physical recovery remain intact. Canonical save schema, world generation, flight internals and assets are unchanged.
